name: Marching Cubes with Topological Correction (Case 6c)
definition: A variant of the Marching Cubes algorithm that resolves topological inconsistencies (holes) in the isosurface by using an alternate facetization for specific cube cases, specifically Case 6 when adjacent to Case 3.
summary: Marching Cubes with Topological Correction (Case 6c) resolves topological holes by applying alternate facetization when a Case 6 cube is adjacent to a Case 3 cube.
